fsm_states_ltssm.name: Detect
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Initial state after PERST# deassertion or unrecoverable Link error. Transmitter looks for a far-end receiver via differential detect circuitry. Same as base PCIe.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Polling
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Bit-lock + block-lock + Lane polarity inversion + Link/Lane number exchange via TS1/TS2. The Data Rate Identifier in TS1/TS2 advertises the supported rates including the 32.0 GT/s bit.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Configuration
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Link Width and Lane Number negotiation. Same sub-states as base PCIe.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: L0
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Normal operational state at the trained rate (up to 32 GT/s). TLPs and DLLPs flow in both directions; SKP ordered sets inserted for clock-tolerance. Lane Margining at the Receiver can run here without interrupting traffic.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: L0s
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Low-power state entered/exited per direction. Fast exit via FTS.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: L1
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Lower-power state requiring both directions in agreement; exit via Recovery.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: L2
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Deep sleep; REFCLK may be off; re-entry restarts LTSSM from Detect.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Recovery
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Re-train / change-data-rate / equalize an already-trained Link. For Gen5 this is where the 32 GT/s data-rate change and the four-phase enhanced equalization (Recovery.Equalization Phase 0-3) occur. Sub-states include Recovery.RcvrLock, Recovery.Equalization, Recovery.RcvrCfg, Recovery.Idle, Recovery.Speed.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Loopback
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Test mode; Loopback Master transmits patterns to Loopback Slave for electrical characterization at the target rate.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Disabled
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Transmitter outputs Electrical Idle on all Lanes; Link electrically off.

fsm_states_ltssm.name: Hot Reset
fsm_states_ltssm.description: Software-initiated reset via TS1 with Hot Reset bit set; returns downstream device to Detect.

fsm_states_equalization.name: EQ_PHASE_0
fsm_states_equalization.description: Initial preset exchange; link partners (and retimers) adopt the requested transmitter preset (P0-P10).

fsm_states_equalization.name: EQ_PHASE_1
fsm_states_equalization.description: Coefficient handshake establishing a usable eye in the training direction.

fsm_states_equalization.name: EQ_PHASE_2
fsm_states_equalization.description: Downstream port requests adjustments to the upstream port's transmitter coefficients.

fsm_states_equalization.name: EQ_PHASE_3
fsm_states_equalization.description: Upstream port requests adjustments to the downstream port's transmitter coefficients; the eye must be open before sustaining 32 GT/s.

fsm_states_data_link_layer.name: DL_Inactive
fsm_states_data_link_layer.description: LTSSM not in an operational link state; Transaction Layer sees the Link as unusable.

fsm_states_data_link_layer.name: DL_Init
fsm_states_data_link_layer.description: Flow Control initialization (InitFC1 → InitFC2 DLLP exchange) on VC0.

fsm_states_data_link_layer.name: DL_Active
fsm_states_data_link_layer.description: Normal operation; TLP send/receive + ACK/NAK + UpdateFC, at the trained rate (up to 32 GT/s).

fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.name: TX_FORM
fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.description: Transaction Layer assembles the TLP header + payload + optional ECRC.

fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.name: TX_SEQ
fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.description: Data Link Layer attaches the next 12-bit Sequence Number and computes the 16-bit LCRC.

fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.name: TX_BLOCK
fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.description: Physical Layer scrambles the bytes and packs them into 128b/130b Data Blocks (2-bit sync header); optional precoding applied; transmitted at 32 GT/s NRZ.

fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.name: TX_RETRY
fsm_states_tlp_transmitter.description: Retry Buffer holds every transmitted TLP until acked; replay on NAK or REPLAY_TIMER expiration.

fsm_states_tlp_receiver.name: RX_BLOCK
fsm_states_tlp_receiver.description: Physical Layer achieves block lock on the 130-bit blocks, de-scrambles the payload, extracts TLP/DLLP bytes.

fsm_states_tlp_receiver.name: RX_LCRC
fsm_states_tlp_receiver.description: Data Link Layer recomputes the 16-bit LCRC + verifies Sequence Number monotonicity.

fsm_states_tlp_receiver.name: RX_ACKNAK
fsm_states_tlp_receiver.description: Ack on good LCRC + Sequence; else NAK with the last good Sequence Number.

fsm_states_tlp_receiver.name: RX_TL
fsm_states_tlp_receiver.description: Hand the TLP to the Transaction Layer for type-specific processing.

fsm_hints.trigger: PERST# deassertion triggers Detect; TS1/TS2 with the Data Rate Identifier (32.0 GT/s bit) selects Gen5; Recovery.Equalization runs the Phase 0-3 enhanced equalization before sustaining 32 GT/s.
fsm_hints.rule: Each transmitted TLP is added to the Retry Buffer; freed when an Ack for that-or-later Sequence arrives; NAK / REPLAY_TIMER triggers replay.
fsm_hints.abort: REPLAY_NUM threshold crossing or failed equalization at 32 GT/s declares the rate/link unrecoverable; the link falls back via Recovery to a lower data rate.

anti_deadlock_rule: Credit-based flow control (six credit types PH/PD/NPH/NPD/CplH/CplD) eliminates retries due to receiver buffer overflow; Completion credits are infinite at the Root Complex side to avoid deadlock with Non-Posted Requests. Unchanged from base PCIe.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: PERST# deassertion → LTSSM Detect → Polling → Configuration → L0 (initially at 2.5 GT/s for backward-compatible bring-up). The link then enters Recovery to negotiate the highest common rate; if both ends advertise 32.0 GT/s, Recovery.Equalization runs the four-phase enhanced equalization (with preset hints and any retimers) before settling at 32 GT/s in L0. Flow Control init unblocks the Transaction Layer.

default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_idle: Electrical Idle when no symbols to send and not in L0.
default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_L0: Continuously transmit scrambled Logical Idle in 128b/130b Data Blocks when in L0 with no TLP/DLLP pending; SKP ordered sets inserted for clock-tolerance and margining control.
default_ready_state_recommendation.RX_idle: Receiver decoders idle (or low-power) when in L0s/L1/L2; wake on FTS / Recovery / Beacon.

configurations.name: x1 Link at 32 GT/s
configurations.description: 1 Lane per direction; ~3.9 GB/s per direction effective.

configurations.name: x2 / x4 / x8 / x12 / x16 / x32 Link
configurations.description: Aggregated Lanes; x16 delivers ~63 GB/s per direction at 32 GT/s. Data striped Lane-by-Lane starting at Lane 0.

timing_dependency_rule: Each Lane runs its own 32 GT/s symbol clock recovered locally (NRZ, 31.25 ps UI). Multi-Lane Links require a de-skew elastic buffer; the Physical Layer inserts SKP ordered sets to absorb ±300 ppm clock-tolerance and to carry margining control. Up to two retimers per link each add latency and participate in equalization.
